scope: Shared Beta hurt/death/color overlay rendering and actual original Hotdog fire activation, GPU atlas animation and visible transparency.
generic_changes: LivingEntityRenderer normal passes use bindTexture; overlays use bindDecorationTexture after renderMore.
Original brightness-scaled red alpha .4 pass covers hurt or death once, followed by a separate optional ARGB multiplier pass.
Original custom renderers retain ownership of replacement render methods and overlays.
Beta native adapter uses NO_OVERLAY to prevent an additional modern hurt tint.
An opt-in world render frame carries exact EQUAL depth/alpha blend state and flushes body/overlay depth transitions; existing overloads retain their prior behavior.

hotdog_mechanism: Existing generic terrain-cell resolution and native animated atlas UV binding already support the original burnDog callback. No production Hotdog identity or invented fire behavior was added.

animation_method.normal_gameplay: Real native cooked-pork interactions tame the original Hotdog; native redstone interaction grants and replicates firepower250. Native client/world ticks animate uploaded fire atlas pixels.
animation_method.isolated_pixel_check: World/entity ticks are frozen, then the standard native TextureAtlas.tick is advanced explicitly. Fixed-camera flame captures and uploaded atlas hashes change with a constant level time.
animation_method.freeze_diagnostic: Minecraft.tick deliberately skips textureManager.tick when isLevelRunningNormally is false. The initial frozen-world-only animation assertion failed for that native reason; the corrected normal and isolated checks passed.

policy.render_environment: WSL Ubuntu Xvfb :99, Mesa llvmpipe; no Sodium/Iris

limits: Bounded renderer coverage: Bunny, Hippo, original custom Ogre/Werewolf overlays, and Hotdog fire; not complete mod compatibility.
Sodium/Iris and shader-pack batching were not tested.
Controlled atlas stepping is a separate render-isolation check, not a claim that native textures continue animating under tick freeze.
Natural breeding/birth and complete Werewolf transformation sequences remain outside this pass.
